name: subagents-panel
description: A live tree of subagents beside the chat: current tool, ordered TODOs, progress, ETA, and message/stop controls.

autoOpen.title: Open the panel when a subagent starts
autoOpen.description: Open (or bring forward) the Subagents pane whenever any subagent is spawned

pingSeconds.title: Ping quiet agents after (seconds)
pingSeconds.description: A running subagent that has not reported its TODOs/ETA for this long gets a message asking it to. 0 turns pinging off.

keepFinishedSeconds.title: Remove finished agents after (seconds)
keepFinishedSeconds.description: Done, failed or stopped agents leave the panel this long after they end. 0 keeps them until /subagents clear.
